observations.summary: Independent verification found that sampled all-survivor runs could overclaim an unexercised subject, argparse usage errors reused the refusal exit, and bounded-sampling documentation implied coverage it did not provide.

success_criteria: A bounded all-survivor sample reports only the observed survivors and never labels the subject probably unexercised.
Invalid --limit values and other argparse usage errors exit with a status distinct from refusal, instrument failure, survivors, and a clean result.
Operator-facing documentation states that any bounded sample can miss any particular mutant, including the motivating mutant.
Focused mutation-guard tests and Gate A pass on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows for the exact candidate bytes.
A fresh independent exact-revision evaluation and correctness/security review are appended without self-promotion.

monitoring_plan.criterion: After an accepted repair, bounded runs remain explicitly sampled, unbounded-only conclusions stay gated on an unbounded run, and CLI exit statuses remain distinguishable.

lesson.reason: The intended durable control is an honest sampled verdict, a distinct usage exit, and regression tests that fail when either contract collapses.
